title: The Exodus from Egypt and the Guidance of the Cloud Pillar and Fire Pillar
description: God leads the people on a detour through the wilderness toward the Sea of Reeds to avoid war with the Philistines. Moses takes Joseph's bones with him, as he had sworn. From Sukkot they travel to Etham, and the Lord goes before them in a cloud pillar by day and a fire pillar by night.
